notes: The counter no longer shows a customer signed in on a PC nobody is using: End session on the terminal, End free from the counter and being signed out by the counter now all end the session at the counter too. End session on the terminal keeps a signed-in customer's time on their account, the same as the counter's End session; only walk-in time is wiped. A coin dropped just before signing out now goes to that customer's account, never the next customer's. Customers now see a card over their game when the counter adds time to their PC. A walk-in can reset the walk-in clock from their own account menu, after a confirmation. Goes with counter 1.30.0 (needed for the card when time is added to an account).
